decision: 5 second time penalty. (1 penalty points awarded, 2 points in total for the 12 month period)
event_name: Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport Document 51 Date 28 July 2019 Time 17:58 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 44 entered the pit lane on the wrong side of the bollard.
offence: Breach of Appendix L Ch. IV Article 4d of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, and car 44 clearly drove across the area between the track and the pit entry, which starts at the bollard at the entry, as defined by the Race Directors Note point 8.2 (document 11). This is a breach of Appendix L Ch. IV Article 4d of the FIA International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 44 Pit Entry
